players.bio: Aurèle Florian Amenda (born 31 July 2003) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Coventry City and the Switzerland national team.
Ben Wilson (born 9 August 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Coventry City.
Bobby Craig Thomas (born 30 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Coventry City.

Solomon Brandon Michael Clarke Thomas-Asante (born 29 December 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Ghana national team. Thomas-Asante began his career with Milton Keynes Dons, where he made his professional debut aged in 2016 aged 17.
Caleb Marfo Yirenkyi (born 15 January 2006) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Coventry City and the Ghana national team.

Carl Andrew Rushworth (born 2 July 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Coventry City. Rushworth spent his early career with the youth teams of Huddersfield Town and FC Halifax Town, before joining Brighton & Hove Albion in 2019, where he had spent loan spells at Worthing, Walsall, Lincoln City, Swansea City, Hull City and Coventry City.

Daniel Ian Bentley (born 13 July 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Wolverhampton Wanderers. He has played in the English Football League for Southend United, Brentford and Bristol City.
Ellis Reco Simms (born 5 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Coventry City.
Ephron Jardell Mason-Clark (born 25 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays for Premier League team Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Jamaica national team.

Ethan Rupert Pinnock (born 29 May 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Jamaica national team. He also spent six years at Isthmian League club Dulwich Hamlet before moving to Forest Green Rovers. In October 2016, Pinnock was called up for the England C national team.

Frank James Lampard OBE (born 20 June 1978) is an English professional football manager and former player who is the manager EFL Championship club Coventry City. As a player, he is widely considered to be one of Chelsea's greatest ever players, and one of the greatest midfielders of his generation.
Ogochukwu Franklin Onyeka (born 1 January 1998) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Coventry City and the Nigeria national team.

Gustavo Martin Emilio Hamer (born 24 June 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in Brazil, he has represented the Netherlands at youth level. After moving to the Netherlands as a child, Hamer began his career at Feyenoord where he progressed through the youth system.
Haji Amir Wright (born March 27, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward or winger for Premier League club Coventry City and the United States national team.
Jack Edward Rudoni (born 14 June 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Coventry City.

Jake Brian Bidwell (born 21 March 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for Premier League club Coventry City. He began his career in the academy at Premier League side Everton and was capped by England at age-group level.

Jay Rhys Dasilva (born 22 April 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Coventry City and the Wales national team. He was also capped 63 times as an England youth international at all levels (from U16 to U21).
Joel Owen Latibeaudiere (born 6 January 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Jamaica national team.
Joshua Elliot Eccles (born 6 April 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Coventry City.

Kaine Kesler-Hayden (born 23 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back or right wing-back for Premier League club Coventry City. A product of the Aston Villa Academy, he captained their under-18 side to victory in the FA Youth Cup in 2021. Kesler has represented England at under-20 level.

Loum Tchaouna (born 8 September 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or right midfielder for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in Chad, Tchaouna represents France at international level.

Luke Matthew Woolfenden (born 21 October 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Coventry City. Primarily a centre-back, he can also play as a right-back. Woolfenden is a graduate of the Ipswich Town youth academy, making his senior debut for the club in 2017.

Matthew Jacob Grimes (born 15 July 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for and is the captain of Premier League club Coventry City. He began his career at Exeter City, where he made his professional debut in League Two in August 2013. In January 2015, he was signed by Premier League club Swansea for an undisclosed fee believed to be around £1.75 million.
Milan Fabrizio van Ewijk (born 8 September 2000) is a Dutch professional professional footballer who plays as a midfielder and right back for Premier League club Coventry City.

Paul Michael Hurst (born 25 September 1974) is an English football manager and former player. Who is currently the manager of EFL Championship club Coventry City As a player, he was a defender from 1993 to 2008, notably playing his entire career at Rotherham United, bar a brief loan spell with Burton Albion in his final year as a player.
Sidiki Cherif (born 15 December 2006) is a Guinean professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Coventry City.
Stephen-Nevin Mutanda Mfuni (born 12 February 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Coventry City, on loan from Manchester City.

Taiwo Micheal Awoniyi is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Coventry City and the Nigeria national team.. Awoniyi's style of play has been compared to that of Rashidi Yekini, Nigeria's all-time highest goalscorer.
Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (坂元 達裕, Sakamoto Tatsuhiro; born 22 October 1996) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Coventry City and the Japan national team.
Victor Torp Overgaard (born 30 July 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or forward for Premier League club Coventry City. He is a former Denmark youth international.

Gnantin Yann-Alexandre Gboho (born 14 January 2001) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for Premier League club Coventry City and the Ivory Coast national team.
